description: This file implements the TlsHandshaker class, which manages TLS handshake processes within the QUIC protocol, including certificate verification, secret management, and error handling.

classes.name: TlsHandshaker::ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Callback class for handling proof verification results during TLS handshake.

classes.name: TlsHandshaker
classes.description: Manages TLS handshake state, certificate verification, secret key management, and error handling for QUIC.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Feeds input data into the TLS handshake process at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshake
methods.description: Progresses the TLS handshake, handling success, retries, and errors.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes the connection with a specified error code and reason.

methods.name: VerifyCert
methods.description: Verifies the peer's certificate chain during handshake.

methods.name: SetWriteSecret
methods.description: Sets the encryption secret for sending data at a given encryption level.

methods.name: SetReadSecret
methods.description: Sets the decryption secret for receiving data at a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances to the next key phase and creates a decrypter for 1-RTT data.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for 1-RTT data using current secrets.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterialForLabel
methods.description: Exports keying material for a specific label and context.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a cryptographic message at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: FlushFlight
methods.description: Flushes handshake messages (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: SendAlert
methods.description: Sends a TLS alert and handles connection closure if needed.
